source_row.rationale: Succession planning helps ensure organizational continuity and leadership readiness by proactively identifying and developing qualified individuals for future leadership roles, reducing the risk of unexpected leadership gaps and supporting sustained organizational effectiveness and staff professional growth.
source_row.source_detail: Leadership development/workforce planning principles support succession preparation and organizational continuity; accessed 2026-08-14.

source_row.stem: A hospital implements a succession planning program to identify and develop future nursing leaders, and a staff nurse at a nonprofit facility assumes this kind of program is really just something for-profit systems do to compete for market share.
